ValidationRule.description: The fields 'Root Cause Department' is required when Root Cause = 'Non adherence to process by IM' or 'Transfer of Inventory (IM at fault)' or 'Allocation/Use of Barcode error (IM at fault)'. The epic for reference #1008
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType_Name__c ="Global Service Case", OR( ISPICKVAL( GSC_Root_Cause__c , "Non adherence to process by IM" ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Root_Cause__c , "Allocation/Use of Barcode error (IM at fault)" ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Root_Cause__c , "Transfer of Inventory (IM at fault)" ) ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Root_Cause_Department__c , "" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Root Cause Department' is required when Root Cause is selected.
